# Svatantrya Reader (svread)

> Machine-readable Trika Shaivism library. Measured state: 101 works in our translation pipeline, 87 with passage ledgers, 90 readable now, 55 with a scholar projection, 8 with formalised chunks. Layered translations use T1 (literal gloss), L0 (morphology), ARGMAP (argument), L2 (reading), C1 (essence), L3 (final), L4 (song). Also: 10 Learn Sanskrit lessons, a 555-work bibliography with translation links, live Q&A enquiries, and a scholar workspace.

## Views (single-page app; these URLs load the view)

- Reader (browse; 90 works currently have a reader bundle): https://svatantrya.net/
- Sanskrit lessons (10, Learn/Decode/Recognise tabs): https://svatantrya.net/?view=sanskrit
- Bibliography index (555 works, 11 lost/unverified): https://svatantrya.net/?view=biblio
- Scholar hub (per work, ?work=<id>&view=scholar): drafts, review, signoff, DOI
- Pushing Lab (live enquiries): https://svatantrya.net/pushing.html
- Memory wheels (word/sentence/Trika constructors, machine-derived forms): https://svatantrya.net/wheels.html
- Chat: every page has a chat rail answering from that work's gated passages with citations.

## Data (fetchable JSON, hash-pinned in data/release-manifest.json)

- Bibliography (works, editions, translations+links, lost with basis, formal coverage): https://svatantrya.net/data/biblio.json
- Sanskrit lessons index + rule boxes: https://svatantrya.net/data/sanskrit/index.json
- Per-work reader bundle: https://svatantrya.net/data/<work>.json (55+ works; originals, layers, hashes)
- Scholar projections: https://svatantrya.net/data/scholar/<work>.json (versions, essays, reviews, signoffs, projection_sha256)
- Pushing digest (115 live questions + hound verdicts): https://svatantrya.net/data/pushing.json
- Sanskrit lessons (rendered pages): https://svatantrya.net/data/sanskrit/site/lesson-01.html ... lesson-10.html
- Grammar pack (Vidyut machine derivations for wheel forms, unreviewed): https://svatantrya.net/data/grammar/wheel-pack.json
- Curated-vs-machine cross-check (per-form agreement, specials, gaps): https://svatantrya.net/data/grammar/crosscheck.json
- Learning harness (ONE fetch: all wheels + decision tree + verify index + links): https://svatantrya.net/data/wheels/harness.json
- One-URL answers (no registration, no JS: fetch a form, get verdict + derivation + scripture): https://svatantrya.net/a/<form>/ — index https://svatantrya.net/a/index.json
- Harness master prompt (how a tutor model uses the site): https://svatantrya.net/data/wheels/HARNESS.md
- Wheel datasets (word/sentence/trika/karaka constructors): https://svatantrya.net/data/wheels/word.json, sentence.json, trika.json, karaka.json
- Tutor levels (one prompt file per level, machine-readable): https://svatantrya.net/data/wheels/tutor/level-01-bases.md ... level-06-karaka.md
- Formal registry (every REGISTERED theorem, its scope, and the unformalised gap list): https://svatantrya.net/data/formal.json
- Verification packs + no-code recipe (fetch + sha256sum, no install): https://svatantrya.net/data/verify/index.json
- Trace index (909 chunks; 236 COMPLETE / 673 PARTIAL; per-chunk source->layers->proofs->theorems->essays, hash-pinned): https://svatantrya.net/data/traces/index.json
- Trace bundles (one JSON per chunk, trika-trace/1, re-verifiable): https://svatantrya.net/data/traces/<work>-<target>.json
- Claim pages (one pre-rendered HTML page per chunk: answer-first verdict, passage excerpt, claim table, limits, hashes, verify steps): https://svatantrya.net/claim/<work>/<target>/ — start at a work index https://svatantrya.net/work/<work>/
- This llms.txt is for agents; Google ignores it (measured, 2026). For citation, use a claim page URL.
- Or ask an MCP client with the openpatala-federation gateway for formal__trace {work, target} (plus formal__bridge, formal__gaps, formal__evidence, formal__table, formal__runs, formal__axioms)

## Layers (internal codes -> public names; codes are load-bearing)

T1 draft-translation · L0 literal-gloss · ARGMAP argument-map · L2 reading-translation · C1 essence · C2 register-render · L3 final-translation · L4 song. See trika-x layer-names map.

## How to cite (so answers stay traceable)

- Self-verification (no code, no account): https://svatantrya.net/?view=verify and https://svatantrya.net/VERIFY.md — fetch the trace + pack, sha256sum the bytes, compare. Matching hashes prove identity; they do not prove quality.

- Cite work id + chunk locator (e.g. bhairavastava bh-p02) + immutable_id (pt:pid:...) + projection_sha256 when quoting a projection.
- OURS-* translations are machine-proposed, human review pending — say so. Lost works are scholar-REPORTED (finding-aid basis), not witnessed. Scholar essays are SELF_ATTESTED positions unless independently reviewed — say which.
- Never invent a witness, edition, or DOI. If the record says UNPINNED/BLOCKED/UNVERIFIED, repeat that. For full verification, resolve a formal__trace bundle for the chunk and re-run its hashes.

## Rights

- Sanskrit sources: edition-labelled (mostly GRETIL CC BY-NC-SA); specific edition rights unknown unless stated.
- Our English layers: cite with provenance; style/voice examples need author grant (see Scholar permissions).
